shackleton-de-gerlache-v1.recipe: astro-mine-worlds scripts/build_shackleton_anchor.py --convert --raw-dem LDEM_875S_5M.lbl --metakernel <DE440.tm> --version 0.4.0 --resolution-m 120 --n-azimuth 120 --max-radius-m 30000 --horizon-frame grid --abcorr NONE --psr-start 2025-01-01T00:00:00 --psr-days 365 --psr-step-hours 12 --psr-semantics seasonal, then `worlds publish`. Those flags are exactly the harness validation/shackleton_psr.reference.json grades against, so the bundle carries the numbers that were validated. 0.4.0 is the first anchor world to ship illumination/horizon.zarr (astro-mine-worlds#46); prior bundles made every consumer re-derive the skyline on every load.

astro-mine.fleet.excavator.recipe: fleet publish library/manipulation/excavator.sadf.yaml --registry <reg> --sign --key <key>  # 0.2.0 adds the `tool` contact element (astro-mine-fleet#38); 0.1.0 remains published and immutable

shackleton_water_ice_v1.recipe: prospect publish --registry <reg> --name shackleton_water_ice_v1 --private-key <key>  # 1.0.0 squares the GMRF SPDE operator so alpha=2 yields a valid Matern nu=1 field (astro-mine-prospect#39); 0.1.0 remains published and immutable

astro-mine.link.lunar-polar-relay-dsn.recipe: astro-mine-link scripts/build_anchor_contact_plan.py --metakernel <DE440.tm> --relay-spk <relay_orbiter.bsp> --world-registry <reg> --world-ref shackleton-de-gerlache-v1:0.4.0 --key <key>. Run from the Worlds venv (`uv run --with ../astro-mine-link`): the build needs Link AND the Worlds world_provider entry point, and no single venv has both. 0.3.0 extends the plan's epoch window from 24 h to the full 30-day mission the episode runs (astro-mine-link#34), so comms_robustness scores over the whole episode; nodes carry their Fleet SADF identity.id (0.2.0, astro-mine-link#30) and the plan is rebuilt against the 0.4.0 world, so its provenance.source_content_hashes.terrain equals this scenario's world pin.
